## `watch`

Open a lazy, bounded entity event stream after SUBACK.

```python
async def watch(
    *,
    categories: Collection[EntityCategory] | None = None,
    integrations: Collection[str] | None = None,
    buffer_size: int | None = None,
    delivery: DeliveryPolicy = DeliveryPolicy.FIFO,
) -> EventStream[EntityEvent]
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| categories | Collection[EntityCategory] \| None | None | Entity categories to observe, or all supported categories. |
| integrations | Collection[str] \| None | None | Integration names to observe, or all integrations. |
| buffer_size | int \| None | None | Positive local queue size, or the configured default. |
| delivery | DeliveryPolicy | DeliveryPolicy.FIFO | Local behavior when the stream queue is full. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| EventStream[EntityEvent] | A bounded stream of matching typed entity events. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| AuthorizationError | If the broker rejects a required subscription. |
| ConnectionError | If the MQTT subscription cannot be completed. |
| NotReadyError | If the client has not reached readiness. |
| ResourceLimitError | If the requested queue exceeds the configured limit. |
| ValidationError | If an argument cannot form a supported watcher. |

[Source · interfaces/entities.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/interfaces/entities.py#L37)

## `publish`

Publish one typed entity in the configured wire format.

```python
async def publish(entity: Entity) -> PublicationReceipt
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity | Entity | — | Entity to publish on its exact supported topic. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| PublicationReceipt | The local MQTT publication receipt. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| AuthorizationError | If the broker rejects the publication. |
| ConnectionError | If the MQTT publication cannot be completed. |
| NotReadyError | If the client has not reached readiness. |
| ProtocolError | If the broker returns a malformed or failed PUBACK. |
| ResourceLimitError | If the encoded payload exceeds the byte limit. |
| ValidationError | If the entity cannot be encoded for publication. |

[Source · interfaces/entities.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/interfaces/entities.py#L88)
